PR #85 opened: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/85

**Summary of what was done:**
- Pulled real, live state from Vercel (via `vercel` CLI with the session's token) and GitHub (via `gh api`, not `gh pr view` which turned out to silently truncate long JSON string fields — worked around by using `gh api` directly).
- Added a single new `registries[]` entry to `ai-os/MASTER_INDEX.yaml` (no new file) covering: Vercel plan tier (reconfirmed Hobby), each project's prod deployment status and env var key presence/staleness, and all 7 GitHub repos' branch/PR/workflow/branch-protection state.
- Discovered `SYSTEM_MAP.yaml` and `MASTER_ARCHITECTURE_2026-07-22.yaml`, though referenced by the registries, don't actually exist in this repo — documented that and used `MASTER_INDEX.yaml` directly as the real home.
- Key finding: claude-control PR #84 (KNOWN_CONTEXT said "being verified") was actually already **merged** before this task started — corrected in the census.
- Also found: all 4 private GitHub repos return 403 on the branch-protection API (GitHub Free plan), so required-checks can't be verified there at all — documented as unverifiable rather than guessed.

PR is open, not merged — left for review per the task's constraints.
